name: SVI3_VERSION
description: Read-only -- Protocol version.

name: TYPE_MFG_ID
description: Read-only -- Device type and manufacturer ID.

name: MODEL_ID
description: Read-only -- Device model identifier.

name: TEN_BIT_TEL_AVAIL
description: Read-only -- 10-bit telemetry channels available. Bitmap.

name: SIXTEEN_BIT_TEL_AVAIL
description: Read-only -- 16-bit telemetry channels available. Bitmap.

name: CRC_EN_PSI_VID8
description: Read-only -- [7]:CRC_EN [6:4]:PSI state [0]:VID bit8.

name: VID[7:0]
description: Read-only -- Current VID low byte. V = (VID9bit x 5 + 245) mV. Combine with 0x06[0] for bit8.

name: DEFAULT_SLEW_VID_DEFAULT
description: Read-only -- [7:4]:default slew rate [3:0]:default VID.

name: MAX_VOUT
description: Read-only -- Max output voltage. V = code x 20 mV.

name: MIN_VOUT
description: Read-only -- Min output voltage. V = code x 5 mV.

name: P_SYS_SCALE
description: Read-only -- System power scale. 0=Custom 1=32W 2=64W 3=128W 4=256W 5=512W 6=1024W 7=2048W.

name: DEFAULT_VID
description: Read-only -- Default boot VID[7:0]. V = (VID9bit x 5 + 245) mV. Bit8 from 0x0C[0].

name: DEFAULT_LL
description: Read-only -- Default load-line resistance. LL = code x 25 uOhm = code x 0.025 mOhm.

name: FIRMWARE_ID
description: Read-only -- Firmware identifier.

name: FAULT_STATUS
description: Read-only -- [6]:Phase [5]:VRHOT [4]:OCP_WARN [3]:OTP [2]:UVP [1]:OVP [0]:OCP. 1=fault active.

name: NACK_STATUS
description: Read-only -- [5]:Cmd before ACK [4]:Framing [3]:CRC [2]:Undef reg [1]:Undef payload [0]:Not executable.

name: SLEW_DECAY
description: R/W -- [3:0]:up slew = (code x 2.5 + 2.5) mV/us [4]:down slew 1=1/4x 0=1x [7:5]:decay conditions.

name: LL_ADJUST
description: R/W -- [4:0]: LL% = code x 10. 0=disabled 10=100% 20=200% of DEFAULT_LL(0x0E). Codes 21-31 invalid.

name: VOUT_OFFSET
description: R/W -- Offset = code x 5 - 250 mV. 0=disabled. Applied to VID/VID_MIN/VID_MAX/OVP/UVP.

name: VID_MAX
description: R/W -- Max VID limit. V = (code x 10 + 250) mV. 0=disabled.

name: VID_MIN
description: R/W -- Min VID limit. V = (code x 10 + 250) mV. 0=disabled.

name: TEN_BIT_TEL_EN
description: R/W -- 10-bit telemetry enables. [6]:PIN [5]:VIN [4]:IIN [3]:Temp2 [2]:Temp1 [1]:VOUT [0]:IOUT. 1=enabled.

name: SIXTEEN_BIT_TEL_EN
description: R/W -- 16-bit telemetry enables. Same bitmap as 0x25. 1=enabled.

name: OCP_THRESH
description: R/W -- OCP fault threshold. I = code x 4 x IOUT_SCALE / 512 A. 0=disabled.

name: OCP_WARN_THRESH
description: R/W -- OCP warning threshold. I = code x 4 x IOUT_SCALE / 512 A. 0=disabled.

name: OCP_WARN_PULSE_DELAY
description: R/W -- [7:3]:warn min pulse = code x 0.5 us [2:0]:fault delay = code x 5 us (0=instantaneous).

name: VRHOT_THRESH
description: R/W -- VR hot warning. T = code - 40 C. 0=disabled.

name: OTP_THRESH
description: R/W -- Over-temp protection. T = code - 40 C. 0=disabled.

name: OVP_UVP_CONFIG
description: R/W -- [7]:OVP ref 0=VID 1=VID_MAX [6:4]:OVP delta=code x 50+50 mV [3]:UVP ref 0=VID 1=VID_MIN [2:0]:UVP delta. 0=disabled.

name: PHASE_SHED
description: R/W -- [7:4]:PSI1 active phase count [3:0]:PSI2 active phase count.

name: I_IN_WARN_THRESH
description: R/W -- Input current warning. I = code x 4 x IIN_SCALE / 512 A. 0=disabled.

name: TEL_IOUT
description: Read-only -- Output current telemetry. 10-bit raw.

name: TEL_VOUT
description: Read-only -- Output voltage telemetry. 10-bit raw.

name: TEL_TEMP
description: Read-only -- Temperature telemetry. 10-bit raw.

name: TEL_POWER
description: Read-only -- Power telemetry. 10-bit raw.
